title: Xdrip stops receiving data from G6 after Bluetooth failed to register error and requires reboot.
symptom: xDrip stops receiving data from the Dexcom G6 after 6-24 hours, with the G5/G6 Status Bluetooth Link showing 'Failed to register application for bluetooth scan' in red. A phone reboot is required to start receiving data again.
evidence_quote: XDrip fails to receive data from G6 device after 6-24 hours with the "Failed to register application for bluetooth scan" and requires a phone reboot to begin receiving data again.
